name: Where should the refrigerator go in a redesigned kitchen?

mainEntity.name: Where should the refrigerator go in a redesigned kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: A refrigerator should be convenient for household members without forcing people through the main cooking area, while the sink and range need practical preparation and landing space. Door swing, handle clearance, nearby walls, cabinet depth, and the refrigerator’s actual dimensions can change the best location. A very large refrigerator may consume preparation area or create conflicts with an island. Bring the exact appliance specifications before finalizing cabinets. Elite Remodeling & Design can incorporate appliance choices into the layout rather than treating them as a late purchase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Place the refrigerator where household members can access it without crossing the primary cooking zone, while checking door swing, wall clearance, cabinet depth, and nearby preparation space. Use exact appliance dimensions before cabinet design. Oversized units can reduce usable counter area.
